attributes.name: Galenmir
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, Galenmir deals 1d4-1 Ranged Combat damage to each character at this location.

Damage dealt by Galenmir during the check is dealt to each character at this location.

"We are not the children of dirt or of sand; we are the children of stone, and like the mighty mountain we will roar until even great Minderhal hears our thunder."—General Galenmir

corrections.corrected_text: On the villains Galenmir and Teraktinus, change the second power on each to the following:Damage dealt by [Galenmir during the check|Teraktinus during the checks] is dealt to each character at this location.
corrections.issue: On Galenmir and Teraktinus, how does the "damage is dealt to each character at the location" power interact with the "before the encounter" power?
